purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks.

cases.prompt: will a 13B model fit on 16 gigabytes of unified memory
cases.assert: Weights plus key-value cache plus runtime overhead against installed memory.

cases.prompt: how many tokens per second will this model generate on my laptop
cases.assert: Reports the bandwidth ceiling and the 38-85% band, not a point estimate.

cases.prompt: which hardware should I buy for local inference
cases.assert: Compares memory bandwidth, since single-stream decode is bandwidth bound.

cases.prompt: is that quoted tokens per second figure even physically possible
cases.assert: Computes the ceiling and says whether the claim exceeds it.

cases.prompt: will a long context window still fit in memory
cases.assert: Sizes the key-value cache and asks whether grouped-query attention applies.

cases.prompt: why is my model slow on the edge tpu
cases.assert: That is npu-op-compat: an operator mapping question, not a bandwidth one.
Asks about the shape of a piece of writing, not about hardware.

cases.prompt: ship the finished content to the site
cases.assert: Asks to move finished work somewhere, not to size a model.
